description: IRENA renewable energy statistics for one country: installed electrical capacity (MW) and electricity generation (GWh) by technology (total renewable, solar PV, onshore and offshore wind, hydropower, bioenergy, geothermal and more) for recent years, from IRENA's public IRENASTAT database. Levelised generation costs (LCOE) are not in this API and are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-3 country code, e.g. TUR, DEU, USA (required)

technology.description: Optional words to match technologies, comma separated, e.g. solar,wind (default: total renewable, solar PV, onshore wind, renewable hydropower)

years.description: Most recent years to return, 1 to 10 (default 3)

name: energy_irena_renewable_cost_db
title: Energy Irena Renewable Cost Db
